interface_detail: The command-line client (CLI) is capable of running on most devices with Windows, OS X and linux systems such as desktops, servers, NAS devices, and even Raspberry Pi.
tooling: Tier 2 rclone backend (md5, ModTime R/W, case-insensitive, metadata RWU). One of the few Tier-2 providers that is also a real commercial backup service. Duplicati lists Jottacloud as a natively supported provider. Official CLI plus rclone+restic documented by HN commenters.
chaining: We do not limit the storage space you can use on the Jottacloud Personal subscription.

limits.value: upload speed gradually reduced after 5 TB

limits_note: Per-ip-shaping: upload speed throttled above 5 TB, described by HN as a 'harsh inflection' around 16 TB. Quotas are quoted in decimal TB, not TiB. Rclone about reports 9.095 TiB for a 10 TB plan (forum.rclone.org/t/45928), so the real capacity is ~9% smaller than the marketing number.
reliability_note: Long-running, well-documented provider; the throttle is policy, not breakage. The TB-vs-TiB reporting gap is measured, not speculative.
confidence_note: the Unlimited plan price and its upload throttle are stated on the pricing page

extras.quota_verbatim: 5 GB free. 'Unlimited*' Personal at USD 12.99/mo or USD 129.90/yr, with the asterisk being 'upload speed gradually reduced after 5 TB'. Home 1 TB NOK 79/mo, Pro up to 50 TB.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-ip-shaping: upload speed throttled above 5 TB, described by HN as a 'harsh inflection' around 16 TB. Quotas are quoted in decimal TB, not TiB — rclone about reports 9.095 TiB for a 10 TB plan (forum.rclone.org/t/45928), so the real capacity is ~9% smaller than the marketing number.
extras.egress_verbatim: No egress charge — 'No bandwidth limitation' is listed on Home 1 TB, and the Unlimited plan's only stated constraint is upload throttling, not download metering.
extras.chaining_verbatim: The only candidate here whose free-tier ceiling is 'unlimited' at a flat price, so it is the single account that can absorb a whole 20 TB archive without sharding — at the cost of upload speed past 5 TB. Pairs naturally as the durable tier under rclone crypt.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Tier 2 rclone backend (md5, ModTime R/W, case-insensitive, metadata RWU) — one of the few Tier-2 providers that is also a real commercial backup service. Duplicati lists Jottacloud as a natively supported provider. Official CLI plus rclone+restic documented by HN commenters.
